title: anaphalis sinica var. alata
intro: Anaphalis sinica var. alata, commonly known as Himalayan pearly everlasting or alpine anaphalis, is a flowering plant belonging to the family Asteraceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Anaphalis sinica var. alata include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral properties, which help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant activity, attributed to the bioactive constituents such as sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its potential health benefits.
